title: Abyssals v0.90.40 — Bag Artwork and Exchange Lift
notes: Matching inventory artwork for all bag supplies, held items, evolution items and nursery supplies. Type-coloured move codexes. Patient Rations retired from shops, rewards and combat; existing stock converts one-for-one to Slow Stew. Adds a walk-in Grand Exchange lift with floor and shop descriptions. Development patch staged without triggering an APK build; further requested changes will be included before release. Corrects the mirrored right-facing walking frame for Waranwei. New branch families remain review proposals outside the game until approved.
